records.title: M3-T11-216 — Double-unitary phase/full-S router and shared-gcd joint tail
records.content:
﻿M3-T11-216 — Double-unitary phase/full-S router and shared-gcd joint tail


STATUS: PROVED_DOUBLE_UNITARY_PHASE_FULLS_ROUTER / PROVED_TAUS_EQUALS_GCD_C_D / PROVED_POWERFUL_QUOTIENT / PROVED_TAUQ_CUBIC_TAIL / PROVED_SHARED_GCD_JOINT_TAIL / LARGE_TAUS_OCCUPANCY_OPEN / GLOBAL_COUNTING_CREDIT=0.
Authority: fresh Stage37 MAIN/CARD-INDEX/short RESULT-LEDGER/latest215, targeted active ROUTE, retained183–186 and203. Gate OPEN. No retraction. Independent hostile audit186–216 NOT RUN; separate audit162–185 unchanged. TI parked;120 retracted;147–149 frozen.


1. Decision


215 closed the automatic graph-character iteration and returned to the separate OPEN large-c_u/full-S-denominator same-physical occupancy problem.


Retain
    H=H_content=h1*h2*h3,
    R=H*tau,
    c=c_u,
    D=D_S,
    q=q_phase=R/D,
with186
    H*c*D^2=R^3,
    c=tau*q^2,
and203
    H_Q=gcd(H,q) || H,
    H_S=H/H_Q divides D.
Here || means unitary divisor.


The new result is that the phase/full-S split is simultaneously unitary on the entire tau coordinate, not only on H. This identifies the exact common factor gcd(c,D), converts the nonshared part of c into a square-cube form, and yields an actual threshold-specific joint occupancy bound.


2. Double-unitary router


Define
    tau_Q := q/H_Q,
    tau_S := D/H_S.                              (216.1)
Both are positive integers by203 and q*D=R=H*tau.


Primewise use the exact186/203 rows.


For p^alpha||H and beta=v_p(tau)>0:
(A) v_p(q)=alpha+beta, v_p(D)=0;
(B) v_p(q)=alpha,      v_p(D)=beta;
(C) v_p(q)=0,          v_p(D)=alpha+beta.


Therefore the corresponding (H_Q,H_S,tau_Q,tau_S) p-depths are
(A) (alpha,0,beta,0),
(B) (alpha,0,0,beta),
(C) (0,alpha,0,beta).                            (216.2)


For beta=0 these collapse to the visible/hidden saturated rows.


At p not dividing H, the retained186 fresh rows have either
    v_p(q)=beta, v_p(D)=0
or
    v_p(q)=0,    v_p(D)=beta,
so again the whole tau prime-power block goes to exactly one side.


Hence globally
    tau=tau_Q*tau_S,
    gcd(tau_Q,tau_S)=1,                          (216.3)
and tau_Q is a unitary divisor of tau.


Together with203:
    H=H_Q*H_S,
    gcd(H_Q,H_S)=1.                              (216.4)


Moreover a prime in H_S is necessarily a row(C) prime, so its tau block also lies on the S side. Thus
    gcd(H_S,tau_Q)=1.                            (216.5)


The exact phase/full-S factorization is therefore
    q=H_Q*tau_Q,
    D=H_S*tau_S.                                (216.6)


This is stronger than the bare qD=R product and stronger than203's H-only unitary router.


3. Exact shared gcd and square-cube quotient


Substitute(216.3),(216.6) into c=tau*q^2:
    c=tau_S * H_Q^2 * tau_Q^3.                 (216.7)


Because D=H_S*tau_S and gcd(H_S,H_Q^2*tau_Q^3)=1 by(216.4)–(216.5),
    gcd(c,D)=tau_S.                             (216.8)


Put
    g_S:=gcd(c,D).                               (216.9)
Then exactly
    g_S=tau_S,
    D/g_S=H_S,
    c/g_S=H_Q^2*tau_Q^3.                       (216.10)


In particular c/g_S is powerful/squareful: every prime dividing it has exponent at least2.


There is a sharper q-coordinate form. Since q=H_Q*tau_Q,
    c/g_S=q^2*tau_Q,                            (216.11)
and tau_Q divides q. Therefore
    q^2 | c/g_S | q^3,                          (216.12)
with exact recovery
    tau_Q=(c/g_S)/q^2,
    H_Q=q^3/(c/g_S).                            (216.13)


Thus the nonshared part of the common-u denominator lies in a very thin divisor interval between the square and cube of the actual phase coordinate q.


No density independence is used; these are identities on the same physical endpoint.


4. Relation to203 and193


203's visible content factor H_Q is only one component of q. The new theorem shows that the entire residual tau factor also splits unitarily.


At every fresh all-same prime, the full tau block lies in tau_Q. Hence184/193's T0=tau_0^sharp divides tau_Q. The new tau_Q cubic receiver below therefore extends the193 T0^3|c mechanism to every q-side tau block, including content-supported row(A) contributions.


Do not multiply the new tau_Q tail by193's T0 tail: T0 is a divisor of tau_Q and the latter is the stronger receiver.


5. All-content tau_Q cubic tail


Retain183's uniform global fixed-c endpoint fiber
    m_c(C;B)<=B^o(1)
on the finite nonzero-u physical population.


From(216.7),
    tau_Q^3 | c.                                (216.14)


Let E_Q(Z,T) be retained physical endpoints with
    c<=Z,
    tau_Q>=T.
For each integer t>=T, the possible c values are contained among multiples of t^3 up to Z, at most Z/t^3. Using the fixed-c fiber and summing,
    #E_Q(Z,T)
      <= B^o * sum_(t>=T) Z/t^3
      <= (Z/T^2) B^o.                           (216.15)


This is all-content and has no outer content multiplier.


More generally, because H_Q^2*tau_Q^3 divides c,
    #E(c<=Z,H_Q>=A,tau_Q>=T)
      <= (Z/(A*T^2)) B^o.                       (216.16)


The A=T=1 cases are not claimed as new. Equation(216.15) is the useful extension of the cubic receiver. It is not independent of186's q tail; it resolves the tau_Q-heavy portion of q more strongly.


6. Small-shared-gcd occupancy compression


Equation(216.7) is exact, not just divisibility:
    c=g_S * H_Q^2 * tau_Q^3.                   (216.17)


Fix thresholds Z,G>=1 and count endpoints with
    c<=Z,
    g_S<=G.


For fixed g=g_S and t=tau_Q, the possible positive H_Q satisfy
    H_Q <= sqrt(Z/(g*t^3)).
Therefore the number of exact triples (g,H_Q,tau_Q) is
    <= sum_(g<=G) sum_(t>=1) sqrt(Z/(g*t^3))
    << sqrt(Z) * sum_(g<=G)g^(-1/2) * sum_(t>=1)t^(-3/2)
    << sqrt(Z*G).                                (216.18)


Each resulting c label has at most B^o physical endpoints by183. Hence
    #E(c<=Z, gcd(c,D)<=G)
      <= sqrt(Z*G) * B^o.                       (216.19)


This is a genuine same-physical joint occupancy estimate. It is stronger than the old #E(c<=Z)<=Z B^o whenever G=o(Z).


7. Add a large full-S denominator


Now also impose
    D>=L.


From qD=R<=B,
    q<=B/L.                                     (216.20)


By(216.11), with d=tau_Q,
    c=g_S*q^2*d,
    d|q.                                        (216.21)


For g<=G and q<=B/L, the number of exact (g,q,d) triples is at most
    sum_(g<=G) sum_(q<=B/L) tau(q)
    <= (G*B/L) B^o.                             (216.22)


Again use183 fixed-c multiplicity. Combining(216.19) and(216.22),
    #E(c<=Z, D>=L, gcd(c,D)<=G)
      <= B^o * min( sqrt(Z*G), G*B/L ).         (216.23)


This is the requested threshold-specific same-physical large-c/full-S joint receiver. It retains the actual c,D,q identities; no ambient denominator density or independent square-divisor probability is inserted.


8. Scoped disposal windows


Against the retained comparison scale B^(1/3), for any fixed eta>0 the small-shared-gcd subpopulation in(216.23) is negligible whenever either


    Z*G <= B^(2/3-2eta),                         (216.24)


or


    G*B/L <= B^(1/3-eta).                       (216.25)


The statement is intended dyadically: on a cell with c in a bounded-ratio interval and D>=L, use its upper endpoint as Z.


Thus a cell that is not already negligible by(216.23) must push mass into a genuinely large shared factor
    g_S=tau_S=gcd(c,D).                          (216.26)


This is new structural localization. The hard part is no longer an undifferentiated pair of large labels c and D.


9. What remains open


The theorem does NOT close the full large-c_u/full-S residual.


The surviving branch may have large
    tau_S=gcd(c,D),
which enters c only linearly:
    c=tau_S*H_Q^2*tau_Q^3,
while
    D=H_S*tau_S.


The exact identities alone permit the extreme subshape H_Q=tau_Q=1, so c=tau_S and D=H_S*tau_S. Therefore no further power saving on the large-tau_S branch follows from the square-cube quotient by itself.


Likewise a large hidden content factor H_S can coexist with the same shared tau_S. Any next count must use original physical information beyond the denominator conservation: N_T, primitive space triangles, four-square/intrinsic-R reconstruction,171/174 sectors, or another same-measure global restriction.


Do NOT:
- count H_Q^2 and tau_Q^3 as independent density savings;
- multiply216.15 by193's T0 tail;
- multiply216.23 by186's q tail as independent credit;
- identify q_phase with174 q_min;
- restart K1 conductor177–181;
- revive134-superseded fresh amplified C_u;
- infer scarcity of large tau_S from the fact that it is a gcd.


10. Verification


The proof is an exact specialization/recombination of the186 local depth tables and203 H-unitary router.


A deterministic exponent replay checked:
- alpha=1..12, beta=0..12 for all realized content rows(A),(B),(C) with the saturated collapse;
- beta=1..12 for both fresh q-side and fresh S-side rows.


480 local exponent states were checked.


PASS in every case:
- tau=tau_Q*tau_S with a whole beta block on one side;
- c-depth = v(tau_S)+2v(H_Q)+3v(tau_Q);
- D-depth = v(H_S)+v(tau_S);
- min(v(c),v(D))=v(tau_S);
- gcd(H_S,H_Q^2*tau_Q^3)=1 primewise;
- v(c/g_S)=2v(q)+v(tau_Q).


This is a finite symbolic consistency audit of the exact retained tables, not an independent hostile audit and not an endpoint enumeration.


11. NEXT217


The q-side tau component now has a cubic summed tail, and the small-shared-gcd portion of the large-c/full-S problem has the joint bound(216.23).


NEXT217 should restrict to the surviving large
    tau_S=gcd(c_u,D_S)
branch.


Use the exact factorization
    c=tau_S*H_Q^2*tau_Q^3,
    D=H_S*tau_S,
    q=H_Q*tau_Q,
with203's original numerator bridge
    H_Q=gcd(H,|N_T|),
and the row(B)/(C)/fresh-S distinction on tau_S primes.


Primary target: prove a same-physical summed bound for large tau_S, or split it into a part visible in N_T/space-triangle gcd data and a genuinely hidden part controlled by H_S/171/174/four-square reconstruction.


Do not return to generic supported-integer counting alone: tau_S appears only to first power in c, so that route has no built-in cubic/square gain.


Gate OPEN; global counting credit0.

records.title: M3-T11-215 — 4bn linearization, fixed-radicand fiber, and squareclass-collision firewall
records.content:
﻿M3-T11-215 — 4bn linearization, fixed-radicand fiber, and squareclass-collision firewall


STATUS: PROVED_4BN_PRODUCT_LINEARIZATION / PROVED_209_BRANCH_EQUIVALENCE_FIREWALL / PROVED_FIXED_MISSING_RADICAND_BO1 / PROVED_EXACT_VALUE_COLLISION_ENERGY / SUMMED_SMALL_MISSING_DIAGONAL_SECTOR / SQUARECLASS_DILATION_CORRELATION_OPEN / GLOBAL_COUNTING_CREDIT=0.
Authority: fresh Stage37 MAIN/operational CARD-INDEX/short RESULT-LEDGER/latest214, targeted active ROUTE, retained Stage14-4bn exact physical-pair bijection, M3-XG-005–008,209,212,214,158. Gate OPEN. No retraction. Independent hostile audit186–215 NOT RUN; separate audit162–185 unchanged. TI parked;120 retracted;147–149 frozen.


1. Result and scope


214 reduced the current endpoint test on the endpoint-safe raw two-face support X* to the single missing-face square condition


    M_x=R^2-a^2=b^2+c^2 is a square,


and to the symmetric graph kernel


    J(F1,F2)=g^2 M_x.


The remaining proposed attack was the moving graph-edge character sum
    C_x(p,q)=sum_(x in X*) chi_pq(M_x).


This card makes two exact reductions.


First, in the exact Stage14-4bn positive cross-square coordinates, M_x factors into two linear forms whose normalized factors are literally the already-retained209 branches A_-,A_+. Thus factorizing the214 product receiver does not create a new independent detector.


Second, fixing the integer value M_x=m gives only B^o(1) actual raw objects. Hence equal-value collision energy is already subpolynomial per object. The unresolved collision is strictly the larger relation M1/M2 in Q^{*2}, i.e. movement inside one quadratic squareclass by a square multiplier. This isolates the exact analytic gate behind214 and158.


A new summed endpoint sector also follows: fixed missing third-face diagonal has B^o(1) multiplicity, so sufficiently small missing diagonal is negligible at the active target scale.


2. Exact 4bn linearization of the214 kernel


Use the exact Stage14-4bn B-admissible positive cross-square pair


    F2=(S2,X2,H2),
    F3=(S3,X3,H3),


and put


    k=gcd(X2,X3).


Let the reconstructed primitive first face be


    F1=(S,X,H).


Stage14-4bn and M3-XG-008 give, with g=gcd(S,S2) and c0=gcd(H,X2)=X2/k,


    H*S2 = g*c0*S3,                              (215.1)
    S*X2 = g*c0*X3,                              (215.2)
    R = c0*H3 = X2*H3/k.                         (215.3)


Equation(215.2) immediately gives


    k*S = g*X3.                                   (215.4)


Let


    Y^2=(S3*X2)^2-(X3*S2)^2 >0                   (215.5)


be the positive cross-square of4bn. Since X^2=H^2-S^2, equations(215.1)–(215.4) give exactly


    k*X*S2 = g*Y.                                 (215.6)


The primitive raw cuboid edges reconstructed by4bn are


    a=S*S2/g,
    b=X*S2/g,
    c=X2*S/g.


Therefore


    a = X3*S2/k,                                  (215.7)
    b = Y/k,                                      (215.8)
    c = X2*X3/k,                                  (215.9)
    R = X2*H3/k.                                  (215.10)


This is an exact same-physical coordinate dictionary; no ambient pair enlargement is made.


Consequently the214 missing-face radicand becomes


    M_x=R^2-a^2=b^2+c^2
       =[Y^2+(X2*X3)^2]/k^2
       =[(X2*H3)^2-(X3*S2)^2]/k^2.              (215.11)


Equivalently,


    Y^2+(X2*X3)^2
      =(X2*H3-X3*S2)(X2*H3+X3*S2)
      =k^2 M_x.                                   (215.12)


Thus a full endpoint inside the exact4bn physical-pair image is equivalent to the second Pythagorean lift


    Y^2+(X2*X3)^2 is a square,                    (215.13)


or equivalently to M_x being a square. This is a reformulation of214, not a new probability factor.


3. The two linear factors are exactly209 A_minus,A_plus


Let


    h=gcd(R,a).


Using(215.7),(215.10), gcd(X2/k,X3/k)=1, primitive-face coprimality
gcd(X2,S2)=1 and gcd(H3,X3)=1, every common prime of R and a is forced into H3 and S2, and conversely. Hence


    h=gcd(H3,S2).                                 (215.14)


Retain209's normalization


    D=R/h,
    u=a/h,
    eps=2 if a is odd, eps=1 otherwise,
    A_-=(D-u)/eps,
    A_+=(D+u)/eps.                                (215.15)


From(215.7),(215.10),


    X2*H3-X3*S2 = k(R-a),
    X2*H3+X3*S2 = k(R+a).                        (215.16)


Therefore exactly


    (X2*H3-X3*S2)/(k*eps*h)=A_-,
    (X2*H3+X3*S2)/(k*eps*h)=A_+.                 (215.17)


So the tempting factorization of214's z-free product kernel in4bn variables is precisely the existing209 branch receiver after forced square/scaling normalization.


FIREWALL:
- do not count the two factors in(215.12) as a new detector independent of209;
- do not multiply a saving from214's product score by a saving from209–213 branch scores;
- any future use of the individual factors must explicitly return to the209 branch route and its retained zero/depth/normalization accounting.


4. Content dictionary on the same 4bn edge


The same exact coordinates also identify the three physical edge contents:


    gcd(R,a)=gcd(H3,S2)=h,                       (215.18)
    gcd(R,c)=X2/k=c0,                            (215.19)
    gcd(R,b)=gcd(H2,H3)=c21.                    (215.20)


M3-XG-005–008 already give


    c_raw=c0*c21.                                (215.21)


The three quantities in(215.18)–(215.20) are pairwise coprime on the primitive raw edge. This is a coordinate dictionary, not fresh multiplicative counting credit. On endpoint specializations it is compatible with the retained physical content decomposition; no new independent content density is claimed.


5. Uniform fixed-M raw fiber is B^o(1)


Now work directly on212/214's endpoint-safe physical raw support X*. Fix an integer


    m=M_x=R^2-a^2=b^2+c^2.                      (215.22)


First choose the positive ordered pair (b,c). The number of representations of m as a sum of two squares is


    <= r_2(m) <= 4*tau(m)=B^o(1),               (215.23)


uniformly because m<=R^2<=B^2.


For a fixed b, the already-integral face containing a and b has some integer diagonal p and


    p^2-a^2=b^2,
    (p-a)(p+a)=b^2.                              (215.24)


Thus the number of positive integer possibilities for a is at most


    tau(b^2)=B^o(1).                             (215.25)


Once (a,b,c) is fixed, R is fixed by R^2=a^2+m. The second integral-face condition, space diagonal integrality, primitiveness, canonical ordering, c_chart>C, M_2R and all current masks only delete candidates.


Hence, uniformly for every m,


    nu(m):=#{x in X*:M_x=m} <= B^o(1).          (215.26)


This theorem is on the actual raw two-face measure and does not use equidistribution, fixed-face completion or an endpoint assumption.


As a consequence, the exact-value collision energy satisfies


    E_equal
      :=sum_m nu(m)^2
      <= N* B^o(1),                              (215.27)


where N*=|X*|<=B^(1/2+o(1)) is212's retained host bound.


This is genuine new progress relative to214: repeated equal integer values of the missing radicand are not the source of the correlation obstruction.


6. Summed small missing-third-face-diagonal sector


For a full endpoint write


    f=sqrt(M_x)=sqrt(b^2+c^2).                   (215.28)


Fixing f fixes m=f^2, so(215.26) gives


    #{endpoints in X*: f=f0} <= B^o(1).          (215.29)


Therefore for every Z>=1,


    #{endpoints in X*: f<=Z} <= Z B^o(1).        (215.30)


For the active threshold C=B^gamma and endpoint target scale


    T=B^(1/2-gamma+o(1)),


any fixed eta>0 gives the scoped negligible sector


    f <= B^(1/2-gamma-eta)
    => count <= B^(1/2-gamma-eta+o(1))=o(T).     (215.31)


No credit is multiplied with161's short primitive face-hypotenuse sector,204's small physical edge,205's small reduced space edge or206's small space-gap sector; unions are charged by addition with overlaps once.


7. The remaining collision is squareclass dilation


Let sf(m) be the squarefree part of m and define for squarefree kappa


    mu(kappa)
      :=sum_{y: kappa*y^2<=B^2} nu(kappa*y^2).  (215.32)


The squareclass collision energy attached to the214 coefficient sequence is


    E_sq^(M)
      :=sum_kappa mu(kappa)^2.                  (215.33)


Equation(215.27) controls only the diagonal subrelation m1=m2. It does NOT control pairs


    m1=kappa*y1^2,
    m2=kappa*y2^2,
    y1!=y2.                                      (215.34)


Those moving square multipliers are the exact surviving collision variable.


Moreover214 proves that an object in X* is an endpoint if and only if M_x is a square. Therefore the kappa=1 bucket is exactly the active endpoint count:


    mu(1)=E_tail(B,C).                            (215.35)


Consequently


    E_sq^(M) >= E_tail(B,C)^2.                  (215.36)


This makes158's generic quadratic-large-sieve warning exact for the new214 receiver: a strong a priori estimate for the full squareclass energy cannot be treated as a harmless coefficient bound, because its kappa=1 bucket already contains the quantity being estimated.


The fixed-M theorem(215.26) does not overcome this. The remaining graph theorem must control either:
- the moving dilation support inside each squareclass;
- a signed average of chi_pq(M_x) directly on the actual graph edges;
- or a stronger same-physical arithmetic relation that excludes/limits the kappa=1 bucket.


8. Exact4bn second-lift viewpoint and its limit


Equations(215.5) and(215.13) give a concise two-stage description of a perfect endpoint inside4bn:


    (S3*X2)^2-(X3*S2)^2 = Y^2,                 (215.37)
    Y^2+(X2*X3)^2 = Z^2.                       (215.38)


The first equation is exactly the Stage14 physical raw-edge cross-square condition.
The second is exactly the missing third face.


However(215.12)–(215.17) show that splitting(215.38) into the two difference-of-squares factors simply recovers209 A_-,A_+. Therefore “second cross-square factorization” is not a fresh route by itself.


Likewise Stage14-t36/s6-09 fixed-direction same-squareclass B^o(1) theorems do not automatically yield a moving-F2 global squareclass theorem: their retained conclusion was precisely that active-direction sparsity remained the global obstruction. The current problem is a filtered subgraph with canonical c_chart/content/M_2R masks, so no fixed-direction result is promoted to a global saving without a same-measure sum.


9. Verification


The canonical208 finite raw population was replayed with exact integer arithmetic.


PASS on all255 raw records:
- exact4bn reconstruction and edge dictionary(215.7)–(215.10);
- product identity(215.11)–(215.12);
- linear factors(215.16);
- shared-content identity h=gcd(H3,S2);
- c_raw=c0*c21 and the three pairwise-coprime edge contents.


Finite collision diagnostics:
-255 distinct M_x values among255 raw records; maximum exact-M multiplicity1;
-255 distinct squarefree M_x classes among255 raw records; maximum finite squareclass multiplicity1;
-on the same22-object masked tail used by213/214, all22 M_x values and all22 squareclasses are distinct.


These are diagnostics only. They prove neither asymptotic squareclass sparsity nor endpoint nonexistence. The asymptotic fixed-M theorem is the divisor argument in Section5, not the finite uniqueness observation.


No independent hostile audit was run.


10. Decision and NEXT216


The214 graph-character route has now been reduced to a precise remaining theorem:


    MOVING_SQUARECLASS_DILATION_SUPPORT
    or an equivalent direct signed graph-edge correlation theorem.


Equal-value collision, fixed-face complete sums, sparse-L1 completion and4bn linear-factor attacks are all settled/blocked at their exact scopes.


Per214's explicit fallback, do not automatically iterate another generic character/large-sieve reformulation. Return to the separately OPEN large-c_u/full-S-denominator same-physical joint occupancy.


NEXT216:
Read183–186 and203 only as needed. Start from


    H_content*c_u*D_S^2=R^3,
    c_u=tau*q_phase^2,


together with203's unitary routing of content prime powers between q_phase and D_S.


Seek a threshold-specific SAME-PHYSICAL joint occupancy/tail theorem coupling large c_u and large D_S, retaining171/174/205/206 scoped sectors and all original Gaussian/four-square/intrinsic-R masks.


Do not:
- restart K1 conductor chain177–181;
- reuse214/215 product graph score as an independent saving;
- claim fixed-q_min B^o(1);
- reopen the superseded fresh amplified C_u branch;
- infer a global squareclass theorem from the finite255/22 uniqueness replay.


Gate OPEN; global counting credit0.

records.title: M3-T11-214 — Z-free branch-product graph kernel and alternate square-score receiver
records.content:
﻿M3-T11-214 — Z-free branch-product graph kernel and alternate square-score receiver


STATUS: PROVED_Z_FREE_BRANCH_PRODUCT_COLLAPSE / PROVED_SYMMETRIC_RAW_GRAPH_KERNEL / PROVED_ALTERNATE_ONE_CHARACTER_ENDPOINT_SCORE / PROVED_COMPLETE_PRODUCT_CHARACTER_BOUND / SPARSE_COMPLETION_FIREWALL_RETAINED / GLOBAL_COUNTING_CREDIT=0.
Authority: fresh Stage37 MAIN/operational CARD-INDEX/short RESULT-LEDGER/latest213, with retained212 endpoint-safe graph host, 209–211 score/depth context, Stage14 raw graph gluing, and 213 fixed-face curve.
